title: MA60020: Information And Coding Theory
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Discrete MathematicsGeneral concepts of coding theory, noise and
error correcting codes, linear codes including the hamming, golary, Reed Muller codes. Finite and number fields, algebraic function fields, algebraic
curves and their applications, cyclic codes (including the BCH, Reed-Solomon,
Justesen, Goppa, and quadratic residue codes). Decoding techniques for some
these codes. Applications to information processing.
